### Come, Lord Jesus!
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/come-lord-jesus-december-2020
Passage: Revelation 22:20-21
Points:
- Jesus concludes His final revelation to the church with the comforting assurance that He is coming soon.
- The original persecuted recipients were reminded that their suffering was purposeful and that perseverance in faith brings eternal blessing.
- Because Christ has already conquered sin and Satan, believers can be confident that He will fulfill His promised return.
- Even though God's people may presently appear beleaguered, Christ has decisively secured their victory and future inheritance.
- Believers are urged to cling firmly to Christ in faith and faithfully invite others to trust in Him for eternal life.
